text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ouch-ouch-ouch...
This might actually be... pretty bad.
choice_data_list: Let's take the day off today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...A break...
Ugh... but, well—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is training right now,
aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, um, even if it's just a light workout,
is there anything I could do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty tough, so
I thought pushing myself just a little would be fine...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I-Is that... not okay?
choice_data_list: Now is the time to endure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I-Is that... not okay?
choice_data_list: Now is the time to endure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, right, of course...
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to shift gears.
I'll get plenty of rest now and make a quick recovery...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, the nurse's office is surprisingly quiet, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
............
It feels a little lonely, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black crawled into bed looking somewhat crestfallen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Y-Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Walking, right!
Not running, just walking at a firm pace—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, it's someone from my class! Wow, she's really flying! Looks like so much fun~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
I want to heal up fast and run like that too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm off!
I need to keep doing everything I can right now...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black tripped in her haste,
making her injury even worse...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One-two, one-two... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's nice to do this sort of thing once in a while.
I'm always so greedy and intense, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The breeze feels so nice,
it kind of makes me want to sing~."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Galloping dreams with you~♪
Again and again, hm-hm-hmm~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The walking routine paid off,
and the injury healed without a hitch!
